incentives.name: Computer Data Center Equipment Exemption Program
incentives.law: Act 25 of 2021 (Tax Reform Code sales and use tax exemption)
incentives.what: Exempts qualifying data center owners, operators and tenants from Pennsylvania sales and use tax on computer data center equipment; certificate valid 25 years; minimum investment and job thresholds by county population; at least $1M per year in employee pay to continue

dockets.utility: All electric distribution companies (statewide model tariff)
dockets.what: Interconnection and Tariffs for Large Load Customers: statewide model large-load tariff (data centers and other big loads): cost-causation, collateral, minimum contract terms, clustered interconnection studies, interruptible rate options. Tentative Order Nov 6, 2025; Final Order April 30, 2026 (served May 12, 2026); reconsideration orders June 4 and July 16, 2026

laws_and_bills.name: SB 939, Artificial Intelligence and Data Center Act
laws_and_bills.what: Oversight of high-impact data centers (50 MW+) on energy needs; limits on local ordinances; AI and data center regulatory sandbox (status as of Jan 2026 report)

laws_and_bills.name: HB 1834, Data Center Act
laws_and_bills.what: PUC regulation of data centers: data centers pay for their own grid upgrades, clean energy and low-income assistance funding (as described at Allen Twp meeting); passed House (per Allen Township minutes, March 2026)

laws_and_bills.name: HB 1924, Load Forecast Accountability Act
laws_and_bills.what: PUC oversight of utility reports of energy needs; laid on table Oct 29, 2025

laws_and_bills.name: HB 2061
laws_and_bills.what: Requires data center construction projects to pay prevailing wage; in House Finance Dec 3, 2025

laws_and_bills.name: SB 1114, Pennsylvania Ratepayer Protection Act
laws_and_bills.what: Protects residents and small businesses from data center energy costs; in Senate committee Dec 15, 2025

laws_and_bills.name: HB 1625, Keystone Artificial Intelligence Authority Act
laws_and_bills.what: Streamlined permitting and investment support for target industries including data centers

laws_and_bills.name: SB 991
laws_and_bills.what: Accelerated air, earthwork and stormwater permitting (applies to data center projects); in Senate Environmental Resources and Energy Committee

laws_and_bills.name: HB 2515 and HB 2516, Commercial Data Center Transparency Act
laws_and_bills.what: Standards for responsible, transparent data center development with community involvement (Rep. Jamie Walsh), modeled on Florida proposals

laws_and_bills.name: House six-month data center moratorium bill
laws_and_bills.what: Lehigh Valley Public Media reports the House passed a six-month moratorium bill; Sen. Jarrett Coleman proposed an 18-month municipal moratorium and ending the data center sales tax exemption. Bill numbers not captured

local_rules.what: Council adopted a zoning amendment permitting data centers (4-2-1 vote) on Nov 24, 2025; residents appealed in Common Pleas court
Commissioners voted unanimously in Sept 2025 against a zoning change that would have allowed data centers in office park zones, after a ~300-signature petition
Bill 20 defines data centers, limits them to the most intense industrial zones, 5-acre minimum, water, power, environmental and noise studies, large setbacks
local_rules.status: adopted June 17, 2026 (4-2); amendments considered for Aug 5, 2026

local_rules.what: Proposed data center ordinance: conditional use only, 400-ft setback from residential zones, 55-ft height cap, pre- and post-construction sound reports, water feasibility study
Data center zoning ordinance hearing delayed to May 2026 after 125+ residents turned out
Data center ordinance adopted shortly before Air Products filed its data center plan (Feb 2026 report)

local_rules.place: Middlesex, North Middleton, Hampden and West Pennsboro townships (Cumberland County); Blakely Borough; Anthony Township (Montour County); Conshohocken Borough and Plymouth Township (Montgomery County); East Manchester, West Manchester, Conewago, Windsor, Fairview and Peach Bottom townships (York County)
local_rules.what: Municipalities modifying or reviewing zoning to control data center siting (JSG list)
Temporary moratorium (up to 180 days) on new data center applications while a curative zoning amendment is finished; PNK Group's pending application excluded
Draft data center ordinance and data center overlay map; special meetings July 23 and Aug 20, 2026

Slate Belt Holdings filed a zoning validity challenge (July 2026) claiming the ordinance excludes data centers; supervisors updating a text amendment with water, environmental and power protections and negotiating an MOU
